name: KvikIO reads from FSx for Lustre: compat off (must be direct) vs compat on (CPU bounce)

tasks.name: KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE=off with cuFile strict: a successful read is a direct read
commands: for G in 1 8; do for T in 1 4 16; do $VENV/bin/python $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/kvikio_read.py --label fsx-strict --dir /fsx/gdsio --out $OUT --gpus $G --threads $T --compat off; done; done

tasks.name: KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE=on: KvikIO reads with POSIX into pinned memory and copies
commands: for G in 1 8; do for T in 1 4 16; do $VENV/bin/python $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/kvikio_read.py --label fsx-compat --dir /fsx/gdsio --out $OUT --gpus $G --threads $T --compat on; done; done
